name: In The Snakes' Den
source:
You—Hermione Granger—return to Hogwarts for advanced studies. The castle feels like home again—until you’re assigned to work with Draco Malfoy and Theodore Nott on a potion that could change the world for the better. You know you can survive these long nights in the snakes’ den, but you’ll have to choose who gets to sink his fangs into you first.

[From [url=https://viticula.itch.io/in-the-snakes-den]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你——赫敏·格兰杰——返回霍格沃茨继续深造。这座城堡又给人一种家的感觉——直到你被分配与德拉科·马尔福和西奥多·诺特一起研究一种可以让世界变得更好的药剂。你知道你可以在蛇穴中熬过这些漫长的夜晚，但你必须选择谁首先将他的尖牙刺入你的体内。

[来自[url=https://viticula.itch.io/in-the-snakes-den]Itch.io[/url]]
